notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/6f074915499553a7d62641ab3cc2688a1b81a7bc.gif
Version 1.0.4 has just gone live on Steam, time to update your Armed with Wings! This update addresses a number of bugs reported by the community - that you for you help everyone! This update also re-balances Survival mode. 

I felt that Survival mode takes too long to become challenging. Survival is now dramatically more difficult. Difficulty selection for survival is no longer an option. Enemies will transition into 'futile' after wave 4.

To further complement the survival changes, I've setup a leaderboards page on Steam! Scores are automatically submitted to the board as long as you don't quit mid session. 

Here's the Rearmed Steam Leaderboards Page
Use the dropdown menu to toggle between various leaderboards.

Here's the full change list:

Survival Mode rebalanced
No Difficulty Select on Survival
VS Mode Bugs
Story Score Bugs
Boulder Bugs
Performance enhancements
Survival Freeze fix

notes.title: Armed with Wings: Rearmed Steam full release!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/ea10bc5d69f92a7b162d5ea5334764e9bfd8d5a9.png

Solo indie developer’s sidescroller exits early access after 2 years.
I’m excited to announce that Armed with Wings: Rearmed version 1.0 is now available on Steam! The stylish, black and white platformer exits early access after 2 years of beta. As the sole developer of Armed with Wings, I’m incredibly satisfied to have served players continually through early access.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dEnj8zkHCaQ

A very special thanks to all the players and community members for contributing incredible feedback. Without question, these players have directly influenced the outcome of this game for the better.

What's new in the full release:
Many players have experienced Armed with Wings: Rearmed in one form or another. Whether from Steam or at PAX, online or offline, none have experienced the new features/surprises I’ve prepared for launch:


Weapon Pickups In Story 
Special enemies drop equippable gear. The hunt begins for the best equipment!
Campfires 
Sit by the campfire to change your equipment in-game.
New Difficulty Tier 
Test yourself against 3 difficulties: Normal, Hard and Futile!
New ‘Relic’ Challenge 
Collect all the relics to unlock a special challenge.
New Playable Character 
The teased 3rd character is now unlockable.
New VS Arenas 
More ways to battle your friends in local VS.
And so much more!


Steam Trading Cards
Steam users will be pleased to know that Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons and Profile Backgrounds are available to unlock through Steam. A frequent request, my apologies for the many delays.

Armed with Wings is coming to consoles
Nnooo Publishing has partnered with Sun-Studios to bring Rearmed to both PlayStation 4 and Xbox One: see official Nnooo Press Release here.

Launch Discount and Price
Armed with Wings: Rearmed will remain at the same early access price point of $7.99 for june. The price will raise to $9.99 in mid July to better reflect the added value early access updates. Get the game this week at a 15% launch discount, $6.79!

notes.title: [Update 0.9.0] Armed With Achievements
notes.notes:
January down, 11 to go. This drawn out Early Access campaign started back in May 2015 - and I’ve promised that Achievements will come towards the end of development. Well folks, the end of development draws near as Full Release is just beyond the horizon!

Build 0.9.0 Has Landed!
This latest build brings (you guest it) Achievements! I advise you grab an umbrella, because it’s raining features! 

20 Achievements
New challenges lie ahead for fans and completionists. Collect them all to be awesome. The full list can be seen here.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/5608df5932a6d0af2fd145bd2898c1b4728309ea.png

Rearmed Trials Survival Stage
This has been a while coming! The strategically improved Survival Mode from Rearmed Trials  (the browser demo for Rearmed release last November) has made it’s way to the Steam version! 
Take up your sword, bathe your enemies in thunder, steel and mist! Battle it out against the horde of Imperials... only sometimes they drop weapon pickups to boost your stats! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/d050ba5b3656fcf19316571f9c92dc9465b3e685.png

Hidden Relics
Again, this is for the dedicated and completionists. A Relic is hidden in each of the 40 levels. Can you find them all? I hear they will contribute towards something in the next update.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/c49f6fd028042839bd08914d0be02f6e75569263.png

Vastly Expanded Levels
So you think you’ve mastered all the levels in Rearmed do you? Think again because I’ve changed things up drastically! Many levels have been vastly scaled - more pathways, enemies, challenges… in short - more Game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/d9a161802770d8e08eb9091770e912eb23bb9f03.png

Below is the complete change log:

January 30th 2017 - v0.9.0
Updates
Achievements
Hidden Relics
Rearmed Trials Survival Stage
Major Update to most levels
Vandheer Castle Music - Heartbeat Halls
New Audio Track - Brave Feet
New Grunt Enemy

Fixes & balancing
Improved dialog
Teleportation collision improved
Speed Booster bug fixed
Timer reset bug
Counter Attack Improvements
Attack Hit Box adjustments
Portal VFX update
Lvl 1 Recovery VFX update
Survival adjustments
Various bugs and fixes


The end of Early Access is just beyond the horizon - not much further to go. I’m pleased with how the game is shaping up and I couldn’t have done it without the community support, so thank you. 

Don't forget we have an active Discord Community that you could be apart of!

Follow Armed With Wings on Twitter: @armedwithwings

Keep your radar tuned to Armed with Wings. The excitement builds now!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/5d45a0d943c3dd0b0c6f107fead66551959fc3c5.png

notes.title: [Update 0.8.28] More Castle, More Stable!
notes.notes:
A big thank you to all the players! Rearmed has had a health early access campaign because of you! The accumulated feedback from the steam forums, sun-studios forums, social media and Discord has aided me to deliver v0.8.28!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8252239/48155cf0dbb776742a3131063b9d674ddeaac7c5.gif

BALANCING. Enemy difficulty has been adjusted across the board. Game difficulty is much more reasonable.
LEVEL EXPANSION. Vandheer's Castle just got much bigger. The Stomping Pillars have been enhanced too, and can crush enemies!
STABILITY. So many fixes! I don't encounter all issues that players have, so some bugs are very difficult to fix. Thank you to Kenji88 and Blackout for helping me identify the issues.

Here's the full change log:
Updates
-30HP enemies explode
Rocks take damage and break

Level Updates
Level 30
Level 33
Level 34
Level 35
Level 37
Other level adjustments

Fixes & balancing
Continue GameData Bug
Level 30 crash fixed
Projectile bugs
Slope bugs
Revival restores health to 10%
Lone Warrior dash adjustments
Razor attack changes
Overall difficulty balancing
Story Survival balancing
Various bugs and fixes


Join our growing Discord community! Our channel is growing quickly, come join the daily Armed with Wings discussion with myself and all the super fans :)

notes.title: [Update 0.8.25] Rearmed returning to PAX Australia
notes.notes:
2015 Indie Showcase Winner, Armed with Wings Rearmed returns to PAX Aus! Survival Demo Available!

http://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/october2016/Rearmed-FB-PAX2016-small.png

Lightning strikes twice! The electrifying Indie Showcase winner Armed with Wings Rearmed returns to Pax Australia in 2016.  

Armed with Wings Rearmed is a 2D Action Platformer with a feathery twist - play as both a Samurai Warrior and his companion Eagle! Explore the dilapidated wasteland of Black Mist, strike down powerful foes and deliver justice to the tyrant King.

Sun-Studios will be hosting a Prized Elimination Tournament on the day where players will battle it out in Multiplayer VS until a winner emerges. The winner will walk away with a Special Armed with Wings Package, so be sure to stop by the PAX Rising Booth for your Armed with Wings experience!

Armed with Wings Rearmed is in active development on Steam Early Access and will transition to Full Release early 2017.

[UPDATE 0.8.25]October Update
Updates
Phase 1 Vandheer Enhancements

Level Updates
Level 29 - Extended, bonus goals
Level 30 - bonus entry

Fixes & balancing
Vandheer Lightning bug fixed!
New Castle Background Lvl 25
New Red Orb Graphic
Improved Portals

notes.notes:
I am VERY happy to release build 0.8.18! I've crafted something interesting, maybe the most interesting addition in a while... you players will be the judge.

I've added defensive abilities to the Soldier enemy. The Soldier can now block your attacks, counter attack and even dodge backwards. This will only apply in Futile and AND for Super Soldiers.

Take a look:

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/august2016/AwWR-EnemyBlocking3.gif

Notice the enemies blocking and avoiding danger! I'd love to get some feedback on this new enemy behavior. Eventually, I be adding the same functionality to the other enemies.

Here's the full update breakdown:

Features & Updates 
	Soldiers can block
	Soldiers can counter attack
	Soldiers can dodge backwards
	New Eagle animations

Fixes & balancing

	Soldier enemy difficulty
        Various minor changes

notes.title: [Update 0.8.15] Refinment

notes.title: [Update 0.8.14] Rearmed Redefined
notes.notes:
Rearmed Reinvented
The Rearmed Armoury has been Reenvision, Reinvented if you will - completely Revamped and now Released. Rediscover the fully Realized Range of arms in Rearmed. 

Before this update...
Rearmed launched into early access with a small selection of Weapons and Boosters. I always felt that the system was lacking in quantity, and in weapon choice. Rearmed only offers the choice of a better weapon, and in my opinion that is not enough choice.

Weapons should be competing against each other for the players attention. Different weapons should be better suited for certain tasks. There should be no Single Ultimate Sword that will forever eclipse any other choice. 

There now, until now I have finally solved this!

What's new in 0.8.14?
A brand new weapon system with 50+ weapons!

Weapons now define your booster set. Each and every weapon has a different configuration of available booster slots as well as linked boosters that cannot be changed. Some weapons even have Ability Booster slots, with 2 maximum. Ability boosters are linked to [Q] and [W] on keyboard, or [X] and [Y] on controller. 


Full Change Log
Features & Updates 
	+50 weapons
	More Unlocks
	New Weapon/Booster system
	New Booster - Speed Boost
	New Booster - Extra Range
	New Booster - Fire Ball
	New Booster - Attack Lunge

Fixes & balancing
	Can use two Ability Boosters
	Performance optimization

Apologies for this long waited update, I fell sick twice during the last month. Development has been incredibly challenging. Most of the work involved reworking the menus to accommodate the new weapon system. I also developed a new 'Weapon Designer' application to help me customize weapons quickly and feed the changes into the game engine. 

The difficult part is now over - the game has never run more smoothly. Feedback on this update would be hugely appreciate! Please leave a comment in the forums :)

notes.title: [Update - 0.7.10] Better 2nd Boss!
notes.notes:
New update is live on Steam build 0.7.10! This is the first update since showcasing Rearmed at PAX Australia earlier this month - thank you to everyone being so patient.

Here's the change list:Features & Updates 	2nd Boss update	Level 17 expanded	Tutorial level updated	Pulleys addedFixes & balancing	Major memory leak plugged    Survival crashing	Hitting rocks	Various bugs

The latest update brings more stability to the experience. I plugged a memory leak that caused the game to become more laggy the longer you keep playing. I've also weeded out some annoying bugs and crashes that were present especially in Survival Mode.

A number of levels have also been adjusted and expanded based on the feedback from PAX. The tutorial level is slightly different towards the end, and level 17 has now been completely transformed. 

http://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/November2015/AwWR-Pully.gif

The 2nd Boss was introduced quite recently, but until now it's been a boring encounter. This update vastly improved the fight by adding more attacks and attack patterns which will cause players to adjust their strategy. It's far more engaging and I look forward to getting some feedback!

http://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/November2015/AwWR-Gif-Boss3.gif

Stay tuned by joining the Armed with Wings Facebook page.

I'd love to hear your feedback on this update! Please comment below or participate in the discussion at the Sun-Studios Forums.

For now that is all the news. Next update will go up in 2 weeks on the 6th of December!

notes.title: [Update - 0.7.9] Smash some rocks!
notes.notes:
PAX Aus is approaching very, VERY quickly. This is such an incredibly busy period as I'm frantically organizing the event - from printed material, chasing down extra TV screens, coordinating with press - not to mention preparing a PAX build... I think I need to lie down. BUT! How can I rest without updating Armed with Wings Rearmed!?
 
Good news, Build 0.7.9 is LIVE! (I pushed the update LIVE on the 16th)

Here's the change list:
UpdatesEnemy Orbs disabled in SurvivalEnemy names updatedRespawn at same locationBoulders drop rocksNew Rock objectLvl 9 expandedBreakable pillarsFixes & balancingEnemy attacking at level spawnLadder bugs fixedMusic bugsBoulder bugsProjectile bugsSpike bonus bugSounds muted during pauseVarious Boss bugs and balancing
Smash some rocks!

Why attack enemies when you can hurl tons of rocks at them instead? This is one of the coolest new features I've added - it's also and idea that I've had bouncing around in my mind for a while. It's great to see this implemented and I can't wait to hear your feedback.

Large boulders now drop x3 rocks when destroyed.Level 9 introduces new Stone Pillars that drop x1 stone upon impact. You can strike these pillars 4 times before it's destroyed.
http://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/october2015/AwWR-Gif-RockBash.gifhttp://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/october2015/AwWR-BoulderSmash.gif
Bigger Level 9

When Rearmed launched into Early Access,  Level 9 was one of the shortest levels. This is no longer the case! I've expanded upon the level greatly - it features tons of enemies, lots of rock pillars and a nifty bit of ladder maneuvering. 
http://sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/october2015/AwWR-Lvl9-2.gif
Bugs Bugs Bugs!

I've scrubbed through the feedback forums, and fixed tons of bugs and issues people have been having. Thank you to all you players who've been posting all the feedback! Honestly I wouldn't have been able to discover some of these rare edge cases. We've now got a build that is more stable and bug free than ever!

There may or may not be a new build until November as I'm gonig to be super busy with PAX. I'll do my best to make as many updates as I can!

If you find any bugs, issues or just have some feedback - please post in the forums both here on Steam or on the Official Sun-Studios Forum.

Follow Armed with Wings on Facebook too! It's a great page filled with artwork and intresting insights on development.

notes.title: Flash Update - Build 0.7.8 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hooray for a quick update!! Build 0.7.8 fixes a few bugs that were introduced from the last update. These have now been fixed - I've even thrown in a few nice additions too!

Updates
- More enemies drop orbs
- Lvl 28 changes
- Lower volume
- Comparable weapon stats

Fixes & balancing
- Survival mode bug fixed
- Orb bug fixed
- Equip menu bugs
- SwitchOrb wall collision
- Lvl 21 boss bugs

While watching some friends play the game, they were having some problems comparing the different stats in weapons, as the stats displayed no markings for the difference between the equip weapon and the highlighted weapon. Now, I've adding simple - & + symbols to show which weapon has greater or lesser stats. 

I've now added Orb drops to more enemies too! Indeed, you are now awarded for defeating enemies which feels AMAZING when you are on low health.

Enjoy the goodness!

notes.title: Flash Update - Build 0.7.8 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hooray for a quick update!! Build 0.7.8 fixes a few bugs that were introduced from the last update. These have now been fixed - I've even thrown in a few nice additions too!

Updates
- More enemies drop orbs
- Lvl 28 changes
- Lower volume
- Comparable weapon stats

Fixes & balancing
- Survival mode bug fixed
- Orb bug fixed
- Equip menu bugs
- SwitchOrb wall collision
- Lvl 21 boss bugs

While watching some friends play the game, they were having some problems comparing the different stats in weapons, as the stats displayed no markings for the difference between the equip weapon and the highlighted weapon. Now, I've adding simple - & + symbols to show which weapon has greater or lesser stats. 

I've now added Orb drops to more enemies too! Indeed, you are now awarded for defeating enemies which feels AMAZING when you are on low health.

Enjoy the goodness!

notes.title: [Update - 0.7.6] New Enemy, Bigger Levels
notes.notes:
It's taken me 4 weeks to get this build out instead of the usual 2 weeks... Sorry about that! I've been very busy with moving offices. Updates will be more frequent in the future :)

Here's the good news! Lots of additions and enhancements!

Features
New Enemy soldier
Bonus goals
Bonus spawn point
Enemy spike pit bonus


Updates
1-2 level merged
levels 3-7 expanded
Rock sprite updated
Power Strike animation


Fixes & balancing
Up-Power strike combo
Enemies pushing boulders
Smoke bug
Enemies falling off edges
Better collision
Various bugs


I've put a lot of work into expanding some of the existing levels. This applies to the first 7 levels, not only are they now longer, but have multiple paths, entry points and exit points. Bonus points are awarded when reaching the more difficult goals! 

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/august2015/Rearmed-3.gif

This update also introduces a new enemy solider - who is a ton of fun to fight against. He's more difficult than regular soldiers - but less challenging than the elites.

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/august2015/Rearmed-0.gif

Another cool feature, hitting enemies into spike pits will award bonus points! 

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/august2015/Rearmed-1.gif

Enjoy the new content! I'll get busy on the next update.
I'll leave y'all with this Combo Fail Gif -

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/august2015/Rearmed-4.gif

notes.title: [Update - 0.7.4] Leaping and aerial attacks
notes.notes:
I'm sure most of you have noticed that there is no 'jumping' in Rearmed, at least in the traditional platformer sense. Some players have even expressed their interest in having a jumping feature implemented.

I was hesitant at first, because introducing jumping this late in development would break some of the level design. But perhaps if I took a new approach to jumping that would serve to enhance combat - I'd be able to satisfy players and myself! And so...

Now you can Leap and perform Aerial Attacks!

This is how it works: Perform the roll by Blocking and hitting Left or Right, continue to hit Left or Right to Leap, then again, and again!

Here's how it looks:

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/july2015/AwWR-Gif-Jumping.gif

You can now attack in the air too! Very helpful for executing technical combos. Try attacking during rolls and the various jumps. Here's a combo I prepared earlier:

http://www.sun-studios.net/other/imagedump/july2015/AwWR-Gif-JumpingUpdateAttack.gif

Here's the full update list:UpdatesRoll/leapAir attacksEdge grabsRoll attacksFixes & balancingCamera zoom in airAttacks on moving platformsUp Power StrikeVarious bugs
  The next update may not focus on any single aspect as I want to lift the quality of the entire experience. Expect many of the loose ends to be fixed in the next two weeks!

notes.title: [Update - 0.7.3] Combos, Juggeling and refinement!
notes.notes:
Last update focused on new and interesting attack mechanics - the response was positive! I'm happy to see players enjoy new the attacks :)

I've just delivered a new update to Steam which makes combat EVEN BETTER! Update 0.7.3 further refines the new attacks in a few ways. The forward and upward Power Strikes are no longer chargeable - they simple happen. I think this helps bring purpose back to the traditional downward Power Strike. The forward Power Strike has a delay before attack. The upwards Power Strike is very quick! Depending on the weapons damage, the power strikes become enhanced.

ALSO, damaged enemies now respond much better, 'bouncing' when they hit the ground - hitting an enemy while they are bouncing continues the combo! There is much more opportunity to juggle enemies with attack combinations.

Some minor adjustments include:
- Holding left or right to scroll through the level select
- Enemies grow more difficult in Survival
- Rolling directions

Here is the full list:
Updates
Attack system
Level Select scroll
Level Select bar
Controls Menu
Enemy bounce
Survival enemies difficulty

Fixes & balancing
Roll Direction
Teleport balancing
Slope collision
Boss bar
Credits freeze
Skulls stuck in walls


If you want to have your say in future updates you can do the following:
Post on the Steam Rearmed Community Forums!
Join the Official discussion at the Sun-Studios forums!
Reach me on Twitter!
Reach me on the Armed with Wings Facebook page!

notes.title: [UPDATE - 0.7.2] New Attacks!
notes.notes:
Rearmed launched onto Early Access 2 weeks ago and have since received tons of helpful feedback! Thank you very much gaming community :) 

Many player have expressed interest in seeing a more complex battle system, similar to what I made in Culmination. I've taken big steps in that direction with this update!

Attacks now span 2 buttons, [A] for attacks and [S] for power strikes. Hold the Up or Down arrow to perform different attacks, whether using normal attacks of power strikes! Discover new attacks by experiments with button + direction combinations!

Here's the update list:
Features
Directional Attack System
Power attack button
New Cave level (lvl 15)

Updates
Smoke added to Super Enemies
New Skull enemy movement
Level 4 extension
More orbs in lvl2
Forward roll direction

Fixes & balancing
Rock dropping on enemies
Adjusted controls
Boss score exploit
Misc bug fixes


If you want to have your say in future updates you can do the following:

Join the Official discussion at the Sun-Studios forums!

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hey Steamers!

Quick note, I've fixed a small error on level 17. When using the gamepad, an instruction will appear and say "Halt with LT (left trigger)". It now says "Halt with RT (right trigger)". 
When controlling the eagle, RT will cause the eagle to halt and freeze position - allowing the Lone Warrior to move around without the eagle. Level 17 requires this to complete.

I'll come more details on the update soon!

-Daniel Sun
